_comment: Stands in for what the Income Tax Department's systems would return: 26AS/AIS reconciliation, CPC validation rules, the officer-side queue and sample notices. None of this touches a real government system.

cpcRules.title: Salary matches Form 26AS
cpcRules.description: The salary you declared is compared against every Form 24Q your employers filed.

cpcRules.title: Interest income matches AIS
cpcRules.description: Banks report your interest under SFT-016 whether or not you declare it.

cpcRules.title: TDS claimed is available in 26AS
cpcRules.description: You cannot claim credit for tax your deductor has not actually deposited.

cpcRules.title: Share sales reported in SFT-017 are accounted for
cpcRules.description: Your broker reports gross sale value; the department expects to see a capital gains schedule.

cpcRules.title: Refund bank account is pre-validated
cpcRules.description: An unvalidated account silently fails the refund, months later.

cpcRules.title: Chapter VI-A claims within statutory limits
cpcRules.description: Claims above the section cap are trimmed automatically at processing.

cpcRules.title: Regime election is consistent
cpcRules.description: Opting out of the new regime for business income requires Form 10-IEA before the due date.

cpcRules.title: Return e-verified within 30 days
cpcRules.description: An unverified return is treated as never filed at all.

checks.title: Capital gains schedule present
checks.detail: SFT-017 sale value ₹14,20,000 reconciled to Schedule CG.

checks.title: Interest income matches AIS
checks.detail: Declared ₹34,500 against ₹34,500 reported, but a second bank has not yet filed.

checks.title: Salary matches Form 26AS
checks.fix: Add the salary from the previous employer and re-file.

checks.title: Return e-verified within 30 days
checks.detail: Verified by Aadhaar OTP on day 2.

checks.title: Refund bank account pre-validated
checks.detail: Federal Bank account validated on 12 June.

checks.title: Regime election consistent
checks.detail: Old regime chosen with presumptive income; Form 10-IEA acknowledgement not yet linked.
checks.fix: File Form 10-IEA before the due date.

checks.title: Return e-verified within 30 days
checks.detail: Filed 6 days ago, not yet verified.

notices.summary: Variance between salary declared and salary reported by deductors
notices.plainEnglish: Two employers reported paying you this year, and your return only mentions one of them. The department has added the missing salary and recalculated your tax.
notices.suggestedAction: If both employers really did pay you, agree with the adjustment and pay the shortfall. If one entry is wrong, disagree and attach the correct Form 16.

notices.summary: Defective return — capital gains schedule missing
notices.plainEnglish: Your broker told the department you sold shares, but the form you filed has nowhere to report that. The return is treated as defective until you re-file on the right form.
notices.suggestedAction: Re-file on ITR-2 with the capital gains schedule completed, within 15 days.

timeline.label: Filed
timeline.description: Your return reached the department's servers and got an acknowledgement number.

timeline.label: Verified
timeline.description: You confirmed it was really you. Without this within 30 days, the return does not exist.

timeline.label: Processing
timeline.description: CPC Bengaluru runs its automated checks against 26AS, AIS and SFT reports.

timeline.label: Refund issued
timeline.description: Intimation u/s 143(1) issued and the refund credited to your pre-validated account.
